summary: Bound checkpoint capture snapshots with persistent mutation fencing, reduce replay memory, and keep proof rollback journals on disk.

replay.detail: Mission-run and planning replay retain ordered claim IDs and decode one body at a time instead of retaining every body. Existing bounded base-replay pages remain unchanged. Projection ordering, per-claim quarantine and proof comparisons are unchanged; no replay is forced on upgrade.

schema.detail: SQLite storage version 17 to 18 adds checkpoint_capture_epoch with a persistent singleton mutation epoch and monotonic sealed-envelope frontier, plus idempotent mutation triggers covering captured bodies, canonical metadata, protection sources, tombstones and repair receipts. Initialization adds only the singleton and triggers; no history scan, body rewrite or projection rebuild is required. The local storage registry/digest is separate from the unchanged claim/wire digest. Proof copies retain disk-backed rollback journals and temporary storage with a fixed 2 MiB page-cache target.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest change. Sealed envelope cuts and canonical ordering remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No replicated claim, checkpoint rule, wire protocol or response-shape change. Capture uses bounded independent snapshots and checks the same persistent epoch with every metadata, body, protection and tombstone page. A concurrent trim, repair or captured-source mutation discards the entire attempt; at most three attempts run before capture returns an error. Ordinary new history beyond the sealed frontier does not invalidate a capture when it leaves protection and captured identities unchanged. Older binaries reject storage version 18; binary rollback requires a pre-upgrade database snapshot. Malformed accepted times fail closed rather than being counted as early or silently excluding an envelope.

downtime.detail: Requires the normal process restart to initialize storage version 18 and its triggers. The migration does not replay history or rebuild projections. Restart-to-API and restart-to-health duration have not been measured for this change.

manual.detail: The checkpoint scratch directory needs disk space for both the database copy and its rollback journal. Capture releases each bounded read snapshot before the next page, allowing the WAL to advance instead of pinning it for the entire body pass. Preserve a pre-upgrade database snapshot if binary rollback is needed. No setting, identity migration or store repair is required.

recovery.detail: The additive storage upgrade preserves existing claims and projections. Older binaries refuse version 18: restore a pre-upgrade database snapshot before binary rollback, or roll forward with the upgraded store. Do not reset the epoch/frontier or manually downgrade user_version on a mutated store. Proof scratch files are removed on completion or error.
